study_identification.author_journal_year: Coupé et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2022
study_identification.title: Hippocampal-amygdalo-ventricular atrophy score: Alzheimer disease detection using normative and pathological lifespan models

clarity_of_research_objectives.reason: The abstract clearly states the goal to develop and validate an MRI-based method (HAVAs) for AD detection and MCI prognosis using normative and pathological lifespan models, and compares against normative modeling, ML and DL.
clarity_of_research_objectives.supporting_text: we present an innovative MRI-based method for Alzheimer disease (AD) detection and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prognostic, using lifespan trajectories ... we propose a novel Hippocampal-Amygdalo-Ventricular Atrophy score (HAVAs) ... validation on three external datasets ... Compared to normative modeling, classical machine learning ...

clear_definition_of_target_population.reason: AD patients, CN controls, and MCI (sMCI/pMCI) are defined and enumerated across datasets, but diagnostic criteria and detailed inclusion definitions are not specified.
clear_definition_of_target_population.supporting_text: AIBL (CN, AD), MIRIAD (CN, AD) and ADNI (sMCI, pMCI) groups with sample sizes, sex ratio, and ages are provided in Tables 1–2.

clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_crite.reason: Quality control exclusions are described, and ClinicaDL was used to define groups, but comprehensive inclusion/exclusion criteria and subject flow details are not reported.
clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_crite.supporting_text: automatic quality control (QC) ... visual assessment ... If the failure was confirmed by our expert, the subject was removed ... We used the ClinicaDL software ... to define the groups ...

validity_of_normative_modeling_outcome_m.reason: Brain measures (segmented structures) are defined, deviation-based scores and 2σ thresholding for normative modeling are described, along with reference populations and interpretation of HAVAs probabilities.
validity_of_normative_modeling_outcome_m.supporting_text: segmented into several structures ... z-score normalization ... proposed HAVAs (S_AD score) reflects the probability ... we used 2σ as threshold to detect abnormal values ...

handling_of_confounding_variables.reason: Age effects are explicitly modeled via lifespan trajectories and volumes are normalized by ICV; sex ratios are reported, but sex and site effects are not modeled as covariates and no harmonization is described.
handling_of_confounding_variables.supporting_text: normalized all the structure volumes using the intracranial cavity volume (ICV)... z-score normalization using all the CN subjects over the entire lifespan ... sample characteristics with sex ratios provided in Tables 1–2.

clarity_of_data_sources.reason: All datasets used for training and testing (C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, ADNI; AIBL, MIRIAD) are named with group counts and demographics.
clarity_of_data_sources.supporting_text: Training dataset ... from seven open access databases (Table 1) ... External dataset used for validation (N=1,039) ... AIBL, MIRIAD, ADNI.

description_of_image_acquisition_protoco.reason: Specific scanner parameters (TR/TE, flip angle, field strength) and acquisition protocols are not reported; only that T1w MRIs were used across open datasets.
description_of_image_acquisition_protoco.supporting_text: training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1).

details_of_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing steps and software are clearly described: denoising, N4 bias correction, affine registration to MNI, automatic QC (RegQCNet), second bias correction, intensity standardization, followed by AssemblyNet DL-based segmentation using Neuromorphometrics protocol.
details_of_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: processed using AssemblyNet ... preprocessing pipeline ... denoising ... inhomogeneity correction ... affine registration ... automatic QC ... second inhomogeneity correction ... final intensity standardization ... segmented ... 250 DL models ... Neuromorphometrics protocol (132 structures).

clarity_of_data_partitioning_methods.reason: Training and testing datasets are explicitly separated by database to prevent leakage (training: multiple databases; testing: AIBL, MIRIAD; prognosis on ADNI MCI). A sensitivity analysis swaps training/testing domains.
clarity_of_data_partitioning_methods.supporting_text: Training dataset ... (Table 1). To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on AIBL and MIRIAD ... used ADNI MCI ... sensitivity analysis using AIBL, OASIS, and MIRIAD for training and ADNI for testing.

details_of_normative_modeling_approach.reason: Lifespan models per structure (linear/quadratic/cubic) with candidate selection via ANOVA F-test and coefficient t-tests; model choice via BIC; distances between CN and AD trajectories; 95% CIs; HAVAs score definition and 2σ normative threshold are described.
details_of_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: considered several low order polynomial models ... candidate only when ... F-statistic ... and ... T-statistic ... select the most relevant model ... BIC ... estimated the distance ... confidence interval ... HAVAs score based on distance to models ... 2σ as threshold ...

details_of_training_algorithm.reason: Model fitting and selection procedures (ANOVA, t-tests, BIC) are detailed; while no iterative optimizer is discussed, criteria and statistical tests for selecting polynomial order are specified.
details_of_training_algorithm.supporting_text: a polynomial model was considered ... when ... F-statistic ... and ... T-statistic ... to select the most relevant model ... we used the Bayesian Information Criterion (Schwarz, 1978).

model_performance_evaluation_metrics.reason: Performance metrics are clearly listed and reported in tables for multiple datasets: BACC, specificity, sensitivity, and AUC.
model_performance_evaluation_metrics.supporting_text: The classification performance ... validated using several metrics: balanced accuracy (BACC), specificity (SPE), sensibility (SEN) and area under the curve (AUC) ... Tables 3 and 5 list these metrics.

implementation_of_internal_validation.reason: Performance on the training ADNI dataset is reported for selected structures, but no cross-validation or separate internal validation split is described.
implementation_of_internal_validation.supporting_text: Performance ... on the training ADNI dataset (404 CN vs. 332 AD) for the 33 selected structures.

external_data_validation.reason: Validation is performed on independent external datasets (AIBL, MIRIAD) for diagnosis and on ADNI MCI for prognosis, with results reported; a sensitivity analysis confirms robustness to training domain.
external_data_validation.supporting_text: Table 5 ... external testing datasets ... AIBL, MIRIAD, ADNI-MCI ... sensitivity analysis using AIBL, OASIS, and MIRIAD for training and ADNI for testing.

description_of_dataset_characteristics.reason: Sample sizes, sex ratios, and age distributions are provided for each dataset, but clinical characteristics (e.g., cognitive scores, medication) and missing data handling are not described.
description_of_dataset_characteristics.supporting_text: Tables 1–2 list N, sex ratios, and ages for each dataset/group.

performance_metrics_and_statistical_unce.reason: Point estimates of BACC, SPE, SEN, and AUC are reported, but confidence intervals or p-values for performance metrics are not provided.
performance_metrics_and_statistical_unce.supporting_text: Tables 3 and 5 report performance metrics without confidence intervals.

consideration_for_reproducibility.reason: Software used is specified with public repositories (AssemblyNet, ClinicaDL). However, no code or trained models for HAVAs are shared, and software versions are not specified.
consideration_for_reproducibility.supporting_text: processed using AssemblyNet software (https://github.com/volBrain/AssemblyNet) ... We used the ClinicaDL software (https://github.com/aramis-lab/clinicadl) ...

interpretation_specific_to_normative_mod.reason: The paper explains normative modeling concepts, uses 2σ thresholds for abnormality, defines HAVAs as a probability-like score based on distance to CN/AD trajectories, and discusses clinical suitability in the abstract.
interpretation_specific_to_normative_mod.supporting_text: normative lifespan modeling is similar to growth charts ... provide an easily interpretable distance ... 2σ as threshold to detect abnormal values ... HAVAs (i.e., the S_AD score) reflects the probability ... well-suited for clinical practice ...

additional_comments.additional_comments: This study builds hybrid CN/AD lifespan models for selected structures and combines them into HAVAs. It emphasizes external validation and compares with normative, ML, and DL baselines. Acquisition parameters and clinical covariates are not detailed; harmonization across multi-site data is not addressed beyond ICV and age modeling.
